source.note: Private chat screenshots were used as planning evidence only; the screenshots themselves are not committed.

decisions.label: Outbound train terminates at Bandra Terminus
decisions.detail: The four outbound passengers get off at Bandra Terminus (BDTS) at 12:30, then continue to Dadar.

decisions.label: Use Dadar railway as the luggage hub
decisions.detail: Do not plan the first luggage drop at Bandra. Continue from Bandra Terminus to Dadar and use the Dadar railway cloak-room/storage plan, subject to the existing access re-verification signal.

decisions.label: Bandra Terminus → Dadar transfer mode remains situational
decisions.detail: The group discussed metro, but Bandra Terminus is not the BKC Metro station. Current route data shows a direct Aqua Line ride from BKC to Dadar at about ₹20, so using metro requires a separate transfer from BDTS to BKC. With four people plus backpacks, default to a direct cab/taxi unless live traffic makes rail/metro materially better. Do not rely on the chat estimate of 10–15 minutes by road as a guaranteed travel time.

decisions.label: Carry at least one physical debit/credit card
decisions.detail: Keep one physical debit or credit card accessible as a cash-access/payment fallback; do not rely only on phones/UPI.

signals.label: At Bandra arrival, compare live cab vs rail/metro to Dadar before leaving BDTS
Confirm one person is carrying an active physical debit/credit card before departure

research.claim: BKC → Dadar is a direct Aqua Line metro ride; current route aggregators show roughly ₹20 and about 7–12 minutes in-train.
research.limitation: This does not include the separate Bandra Terminus → BKC transfer, station walking, ticketing, queues, or festival-day conditions.
